$about: Documented exceptions to the no-hardcoded-customer-string rule for commerce surfaces. check-commerce-i18n.mjs asserts each literal still exists at its file — if one is fixed or moved, update this ledger in the same change. Nothing may be ADDED here without a written justification.

entries.justification: PPR static shell: the layout metadata prerenders without request data, so it cannot know the market locale. Store-default (sk) tab title is served initially; CheckoutDocumentTitle swaps in the market-locale title (checkout.meta.title) client-side after hydration.

Screen-reader-only label of the shared Loader atom. The /checkout and /checkout/complete Suspense fallbacks render inside the PPR static shell (no request locale available), so the store-default (sk) label ships to all markets during the loading state. Known cosmetic limitation; checkout.common.loading stays in the catalog as the reserved localized label for wired call sites.
Environment marker badge rendered only when NEXT_PUBLIC_STAGING_TEST_MODE=true at build time; never set on production builds. Intentionally untranslated.

Untranslated identifier prefix of the demo order number in the dormant demo ConfirmationStep (reachable only by hand-typing ?step=confirmation). Real confirmations use /checkout/complete with the Saleor order number.
Brand-name fallback interpolated into checkout.payment.loadingGateway when the gateway config carries no display name. Brand names are not translated.
